from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ComprehensiveIncome(BaseModel):
    """One company's comprehensive income total from their financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the report")
    comprehensive_income_total: float | None = Field(description="The total comprehensive income amount as a numeric value")
    field_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the comprehensive income line item in the financial statement")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency, e.g., '元'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the value and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    comprehensive_income_records: list[ComprehensiveIncome]
